author: Widogeist
body: The weapon itself is great for crit builds, but the quality on your weapon is only 173% so I wouldn't bother upgrading it right now. Bank it incase you can't get anything better, but if you can get 190%+ I would definitely upgrade it.

author: Constant_Crow
body: I use it for Titans/Yelmogus with my RS Dorado/BoF crit build. Unlike Celestial weapons, you can throw one Ashen Ruby in it and heal through as many Berserk buffs as you like. I dont bother with most tower runs, but for higher anguish (im at 7) or bosses like Yelmogus its really nice.

body: It's my main for raids as RS Raider for crits and damage really good weapon also the ability has the chance to hit multiple enemies if you fight hordes
